description: Golden samples for the M0-003 EntityId/Revision primitives. 'value' follows the case 'kind': entity-id and revision-id are canonical lower-case UUIDv4-compatible strings; project-revision-metadata is the canonical metadata object. Uniqueness contract: the EntityId samples are unique and are disjoint from the RevisionId space; RevisionId values legitimately repeat in metadata references (metadata cases reference the same revision identities as the standalone revision-id cases). The unit test executable parses, validates, deserializes, re-serializes, and compares every case exactly.
